matchOffersV3(address[],uint256[],uint25.details: Match offers from lenders with a borrower -- It can be called by anyone and the msg.sender will get a reward for calling this function

params.indexForCollateral_LendOrder: array of indexes for the collateral on each lend order (in which index is the collateral on acceptedCollaterals)
params.indexForPrinciple_BorrowOrder: array of indexes for the principles on the borrow order (in which index is the principle on acceptedPrinciples)
params.indexPrinciple_LendOrder: array of indexes for the principle on each lend order (in which index is the principle of the lend order on principles param)
params.lendAmountPerOrder: array of amounts you want to get from each lend order
params.lendOrders: array of lend orders you want to get liquidity from
params.porcentageOfRatioPerLendOrder: array of percentages of the ratio you want to get from each lend order (10000 = 100% of the maxRatio)
params.principles: array of principles you want to borrow

matchOffersV3(address[],uint256[],uint25.notice: Calculate ratio for each lend order and the borrower individually and then check if the ratios are within the limits
